title: Bhai Taru Singh prophesies the Nawab's affliction

blocks.text: Taru Singh answers the Nawab's taunt by insisting that his hair was never truly separated from his head, because his scalp went with it. He then turns from defense to prophecy and declares that the Nawab will not escape the consequences of persecuting a saint.

The page explicitly opens the next episode by warning that The Nawab developed a blockage in his urinary tract as the divine answer to this cruelty. Taru Singh's words recast punishment as a spiritual judgment already set in motion.
This makes the page a transition from courtroom martyrdom to the Nawab's bodily torment. The narrative no longer asks whether the ruler will suffer, but only how quickly the curse will take hold.
